name: a memory of this
source:
Today has been a good day, and yet... here you are, feeling like this.  Again. 

A short autobiographical game about trying to cope.  Remembering is scary, and reaching our for help can be even scarier, but that does not mean that we have to be all alone. 

[From [url=https://weefairyfabi.itch.io/a-memory-of-this]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是美好的一天，然而……你却在这里，有这样的感觉。再次。

一款关于尝试应对的简短自传游戏。回忆是可怕的，向我们寻求帮助可能更可怕，但这并不意味着我们必须独自一人。

[来自[url=https://weefairyfabi.itch.io/a-memory-of-this]Itch.io[/url]]
